outcome: Presence of hemorrhage related symptoms and signs
cohort: One hundred patients free from hemorrhage risks who experienced an uneventful elective cesarean section were included.
finding: An uneventful cesarean section provides a safe postoperative and postpartum period for low-risk patients regarding hemorrhage and related complications when standardized surgical procedures are followed.
mod_finding: An uneventful cesarean section provides a safe postoperative and postpartum period for low-risk patients regarding hemorrhage and related complications when standardized surgical procedures are followed.
